text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $64k while Ethereum trades flat, signaling consolidation rather than conviction in either direction. The Fear & Greed index at 26 shows elevated caution, though it's ticked up slightly over the week, suggesting some stabilization after a deeper sell-off. Bitcoin dominance at 56.2% with $45B in daily volume indicates participants are cautious but not panicked—money isn't flowing aggressively into altcoins, and trading activity remains modest relative to highs.
